patch_description: Following the expert recommendation, add two long-range Ising coupling gates to improve connectivity diversity and robustness on harder samples (worst group margin). The current circuit uses only nearest-neighbor and some mid-range entanglement. Adding explicit ZZ coupling between qubits 0-3 (widely separated) and XX coupling between qubits 2-7 enriches the entangling structure without dramatically increasing depth or parameter count. This should improve worst_group_margin (currently 0.37, target >0.40) and reduce the generalization gap by enabling better feature extraction for difficult samples. The gates are added after the main entangler block but before the final post-rotations, maintaining a clean layer structure.
